correctness.rationale: A functional digraph decomposes into cycles with attached rooted in-trees; bounded height is counted by T_0=z, T_(h+1)=z exp(T_h), with F_(h,d)=exp(∑_(j|d)T_h^j/j). Subtracting adjacent heights and Möbius inversion isolates maximum depth and lcm period. At h=0 the positive powers form an ambient permutation cyclic subgroup, at h=1 their positive powers form a cyclic subgroup of order p with its own local identity, so exactly φ(p) positive powers generate the same ambient-identity submonoid; at h≥2, f is the unique power capable of generating f again. Correcting n^n counts only depth≤1 maps; those are determined by cyclic vertex set, its permutation and arbitrary one-step tails. Positive-coefficient bound of 1/(1−ze^z) at z=1/2 and Stirling yields the stated exponential error. Independent literal monoid equality and multiplicity n=1…5 corroborates.
